0x000A21.en: 「I don't care what happens to me!/　I just want to see what AI1 creates!」

0x000A89.en: 「Just give up already!/　The world will become one!!」

0x000AD6.en: 「AI1 is everything to me!/　I need nothing else!!」

0x000B69.en: 「I've been this kind of woman all along!/　You just misunderstood me!/　Fufu... ahahahaha...!!」

0x000BF9.en: 「I've had enough of your cheap justice!/　I'll show you a world with no need for it!!」

0x000CAA.en: 「We'll all vanish anyway, you and me!!」

0x000CEA.en: 「Fine, do as you like!/　It's all ending anyway!!」

0x000E3E.en: 「Into one! All of it into one!!」

0x000E6C.en: 「I see it, I can see it! A wondrous world!」

0x000EAC.en: 「It all fades away! All becomes one!!」

0x000EEC.en: 「How long/ will you cling to such trifles!?」

0x000FB7.en: 「Whatever you do, it's too late! Ahahaha!」

0x001065.en: 「Aqua!/ You don't matter at all!/ Not one bit!!」

0x0010C2.en: 「Useless, all useless!/ I know your every move already!!」

0x001121.en: 「Ufufu, you'll play with AI1?/ Fufu, how naughty...」

0x0011E0.en: 「Fufufu... fine,/ I'll spare you a little while...!」

0x001239.en: 「Ufufu... are you scared?/ Of fading away...」

0x0012FA.en: 「No need to predict!/ I just want the result! Ahahaha!!」

0x001353.en: 「Don't think you can stop me!/ AI1... and me!!」

0x0013A6.en: 「I'll end it all!/ You, and myself too...!」

0x0013F9.en: 「No gods, no men!/ AI1 is all I need!!」

0x00144C.en: 「Not god, not man, not weapon!/ My sweet child shall judge all!!」

0x0014C3.en: 「Come, you too/ become one with AI1...!」
